contexts.text: The residue on standard modules is computed in [[lem-rational-cherednik-standard-module-local-connection-residue]], and the horizontal transport with endpoint identification is computed in [[lem-rational-cherednik-log-connection-meridian-eigenvalues]]; together they give the displayed scalars on each $W_H$-character. The annihilating-polynomial assertion for standards is a separate theorem, [[thm-rational-cherednik-kz-standard-modules-factor-through-hecke]]. To compare residues with GGOR, let $s_H^{\mathrm G}$ denote their reflection with eigenvalue $\zeta_H$ on the normal line $\mathfrak h/H$. Under the present convention, $s_H^{\mathrm G}=s_H^{-1}$. Their character $\det^{-j}|_{W_H}$ therefore has eigenvalue $\zeta_H^j$ for the present generator $s_H$. GGOR's residue $-e_Hk_{H,j}$ on that character matches the locally computed $r_{H,j}$, giving $k_{H,j}=-r_{H,j}/e_H$ with the same character index. Their displayed Hecke root uses their reflection and braid-generator convention; this definition derives $\mu_{H,j}$ from the positive lift and endpoint action fixed here, and does not identify the two root lists without translating the braid generator as well.

The braid-group representation and quotient Hecke algebra are defined here. The standard-module residue calculation is proved locally; factorization for every object of $\mathcal O$ and the quotient equivalence are retained as separate claims with explicit proof status in [[thm-rational-cherednik-kz-factors-through-hecke-algebra]] and [[thm-rational-cherednik-kz-quotient-equivalence-under-bmr-rank]].

[F2] [[lem-rational-cherednik-standard-module-local-connection-residue]] proves the polynomial commutator identity and cancellation of the Dunkl correction. The same calculation permits a nonzero inducing $y$-action.

[F2] The Euler/finite-length proof supplies $[\mathrm{eu},x]=x$, $[\mathrm{eu},y]=-y$, scalar $a_E$ on singular $E$, finite weight spaces for objects, and unique simple heads for standards indexed by irreducible $W$-modules ([[lem-rational-cherednik-category-o-has-finite-length]]).

[F1] PBW and localized Dunkl derivations give the fixed generalized-standard vector space and connection $\partial_y=y+\sum_s c_s\alpha_s(y)\alpha_s^{-1}(1-s)$; KZ is exact and the meridian roots and endpoint action are fixed ([[thm-rational-cherednik-pbw-theorem]], [[lem-rational-cherednik-dunkl-localization-and-flat-connection]], [[def-rational-cherednik-kz-functor-and-finite-hecke-algebra]]).

[F2] For fixed $c$, a uniform Euler bound gives a projective generator inside a sufficiently large generalized standard, and standard extensions can be nontrivial only across positive integral Euler differences ([[thm-rational-cherednik-category-o-projective-generator-from-generalized-standards]]).
Thus on the $s_H$-character with eigenvalue $\zeta_H^j$, the residue acts by $r_{H,j}$ of [[def-rational-cherednik-kz-functor-and-finite-hecke-algebra]].

[F5] [[def-rational-cherednik-kz-functor-and-finite-hecke-algebra]]: $W_H=\langle s_H\rangle$ has order $e_H$, $s_H$ acts by $\zeta_H$ on the conormal line, and $r_{H,j}=\sum_{\ell=1}^{e_H-1}c_{H,\ell}(1-\zeta_H^{j\ell})$.

[F2] [[lem-cherednik-nilpotent-induced-connections-have-moderate-growth]]: horizontal sections, duals and exterior powers of localized objects have uniformly bounded power growth on generic affine coordinate lines, including infinity, in rational frames.
[F3] [[lem-bounded-separate-rationality-is-rational]]: a meromorphic function rational with uniformly bounded degrees on generic coordinate lines is rational in all variables.

[F6] [[def-rational-cherednik-kz-functor-and-finite-hecke-algebra]] defines equivariant monodromy by paths with their endpoint group identifications. A subspace invariant under this representation transports to an equivariant flat analytic subbundle.

[F1] Projectives have standard flags and $\dim\operatorname{Hom}(P(E),M)=[M:L(E)]$; costandards have Hom/Ext1 orthogonality and the same $K_0$ classes as standards ([[thm-rational-cherednik-category-o-projective-generator-from-generalized-standards]], [[lem-rational-cherednik-costandard-orthogonality-and-character]]).

[F2] Localization and KZ are exact, and standard localization has rank $\dim E$; the irreducible degree squares sum to $|W|$ ([[lem-rational-cherednik-dunkl-localization-and-flat-connection]], [[def-rational-cherednik-kz-functor-and-finite-hecke-algebra]], [[cor-sum-of-squares-formula-for-irreducible-degrees]]).

[F1] PBW and standards give the triangular decomposition and induced modules; the Euler/finite-length proof gives the commutators, generalized eigenspaces, and unique simple heads for standards indexed by irreducible $W$-modules ([[thm-rational-cherednik-pbw-theorem]], [[def-rational-cherednik-standard-module]], [[lem-rational-cherednik-category-o-has-finite-length]]).

For every $M\in\mathcal O_c(W,\mathfrak h)$, the KZ braid-group representation $\operatorname{KZ}(M)$ factors through the parameter-specific finite reflection Hecke algebra $\mathcal H_{q(c)}(W)$ defined in [[def-rational-cherednik-kz-functor-and-finite-hecke-algebra]]. No semisimplicity or genericity assumption on $c$ is imposed.

[F1] [[thm-rational-cherednik-category-o-projective-generator-from-generalized-standards]]: for fixed $c$, a direct summand of a generalized regular standard is a finite projective generator of $\mathcal O_c$; every object is a quotient of a finite sum of that generalized standard.

[F2] [[lem-rational-cherednik-kz-relation-specializes-in-flat-family]] proves the exact meridian polynomial identity on all generalized regular standards, by convergent nonresonant gauges and holomorphic continuation of the polynomial-free parameter family.
[F4] [[def-rational-cherednik-kz-functor-and-finite-hecke-algebra]] specifies the target algebra and every defining meridian relation.

[F1] [[thm-cherednik-localized-monodromy-is-fully-faithful-with-subquotient-closed-image]]: the quotient $\mathcal C=\mathcal O_c/\mathcal O_{\rm tor}$ embeds fully faithfully and exactly into braid-group modules with image closed under subobjects and quotients.
[F2] [[thm-rational-cherednik-kz-factors-through-hecke-algebra]]: the embedding has target $\mathcal H=\mathcal H_{q(c)}(W)$-modules.

[F3] [[thm-rational-cherednik-category-o-bgg-reciprocity-and-projective-generator-rank]]: the underlying vector-space KZ functor is $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_c}(P,-)$ for a projective $P=P_{\rm KZ}$, and $\dim\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal O_c}(P)=|W|$; its proof supplies highest-weight structure, BGG reciprocity and the full rank calculation.

For every finite-dimensional $W$-module $E$, each positive reflection meridian acts on $\operatorname{KZ}(\Delta_c(E))$ with eigenvalues among $\mu_{H,0},\dots,\mu_{H,e_H-1}$ from [[def-rational-cherednik-kz-functor-and-finite-hecke-algebra]]. Consequently $\operatorname{KZ}(\Delta_c(E))$ is a module over the defined finite reflection Hecke algebra $\mathcal H_{q(c)}(W)$. No semisimplicity assumption on $\mathcal O_c$ or on the Hecke algebra is made.

[F1] [[lem-rational-cherednik-kz-relation-specializes-in-flat-family]] proves the exact meridian polynomial identities on every generalized standard at every parameter, with the current endpoint and residue conventions.
[F3] [[def-rational-cherednik-kz-functor-and-finite-hecke-algebra]]: the specified reflection Hecke algebra is the braid-group algebra modulo these polynomial identities.
